item.title: For Gabor, the creative process is as important as the finished work.
item.dc:creator: XREAL_Global
item.content:encoded:
For Gabor, the creative process is as important as the finished work.
With a background in architecture and a practice spanning painting, mosaics, stained glass, and sculpture, his work explores the relationship between form, light, and space.
Now, with XREAL AURA, he's experimenting with new ways to visualize, test, and develop ideas in a spatial environment.
Step into his creative process and discover A Bicycle for the Mind
Real people. Real moments. XR, lived.
#XREAL #AURA #AndroidXR

item.title: "It's a human who has to put on the headset and see if your interaction is natural or not."
item.dc:creator: MetaVRDevs
item.content:encoded:
"It's a human who has to put on the headset and see if your interaction is natural or not."
That's @AshrayPai answering a question about agentic tools from Meta developer advocate @Dilmerv in episode 1 of Unscripted, our new series where a developer and a Meta developer advocate candidly take turns answering questions about building on Meta platforms.
In this episode, Ashray and Dilmer shared how they use agentic tools to accelerate VR development. Scaffolding, SDK and package setup, debugging and test runs all go to Ashray's agents. Comfort and interaction quality stay with him, in the headset. He sums it up as anything that needs testing can go to an agent, and anything that requires judging needs a human.
Watch episode 1 to hear how both of them use agentic tools in their day-to-day workflows and stay tuned for more episodes 👉 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZK0-t56JggU #MetaVR #MetaVRGlasses #DevTools #AICoding https://x.com/MetaVRDevs/status/2112667703203021055/video/1

XREAL One Pro set the bar. XREAL 1 Pro+ raises it.

item.title: Pimax Crystal Pro. Wireless Native Foveated Streaming.
item.dc:creator: pimaxofficial
item.content:encoded:
Pimax Crystal Pro. Wireless Native Foveated Streaming.
With eye tracking, Crystal Pro dynamically sends the native GPU signal to your focus area through 60G Airlink, without additional codec or compression. The focus zone updates frame by frame as your gaze moves.
DisplayPort-grade quality. Wirelessly.
✅ Native GPU signal in your focus area ✅ Dynamic frame-by-frame foveated streaming ✅ 6+ Gbps through two MIMO paths ✅ Under 2ms added latency ✅ XR2 chip for frame synchronization ✅ Wi-Fi fallback + Pimax Play management ✅ Airlink Pro mode with ~10 Gbps combined bandwidth
Learn more: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lhJ5d1qS5cM https://x.com/pimaxofficial/status/2108935587537231983/video/1

item.content:encoded:
We’re thrilled to welcome @benz145 to VITURE! Ben brings a wealth of XR expertise and a deep understanding of the community shaping its future. Thank you for your trust, Ben, we can’t wait to build what’s next together!
And congratulations to @vrbosenet on his new role at @RtoVR!
引用 @benz145： I have news.
Longtime editor @vrbosenet is the new Executive Editor of @RtoVR!
I’m stepping back from editorial to the role of Business Director to focus on reader experience and platform. I have also joined @getVITURE as Head of Strategic Partnerships.
With the Executive Editorship in Scott’s hands—and a contractual agreement that VITURE cannot attempt to influence Road to VR by using my position as leverage—I’m confident that Road to VR will retain the editorial independence that we’ve worked to maintain over all these years.
